notablePrerequisites: Archmage Ascension has at least six quest counters on it.
description:
During your draw step, Archmage Ascension allows you to search your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, reveal it and put it into your hand.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.
